text: Link containers and machines with resonance nodes to collect, transfer and distribute items and fluids.

Omnira logistics start at 4 items/s and 2000 mB/s; bucket exchange takes 0.5 seconds. Speed Upgrades multiply these rates. Intake, Output and resonance work at their own limits; external extraction also depends on the extracting device and cannot exceed the container limit.

Each transfer method has its own allowance. Resonance uses the sender limit, Intake its host limit; ordinary receiving is unthrottled. Spacetime Ports only extend adjacent faces, without active transfer or extra limits.
